name: Montalbán de Córdoba (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the arms of Montalbán de Córdoba (a crowned black double-headed eagle bearing a shield).
history: Municipal flag of Montalbán de Córdoba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Montalbán de Córdoba arms — crowned double-headed eagle bearing a shield
